fields.name: Barbell Bench Press
fields.description: The classic chest compound movement using a barbell on a flat bench.
fields.instructions: Lie flat on bench. Grip bar slightly wider than shoulder-width. Lower bar to chest under control. Press back up to full extension. Keep feet flat and back slightly arched.

fields.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
fields.description: A chest press using dumbbells, allowing a greater range of motion than barbell.
fields.instructions: Lie flat on bench holding dumbbells at chest level. Press up until arms are fully extended. Lower slowly to starting position. Keep wrists straight throughout.

fields.name: Push-Up
fields.description: Foundational bodyweight chest and tricep exercise.
fields.instructions: Start in a high plank. Keep body straight from head to heels. Lower chest toward floor. Press back up. Do not let hips sag or pike.

fields.name: Dumbbell Fly
fields.description: Chest isolation movement targeting the pectoral stretch.
fields.instructions: Lie on bench, dumbbells above chest. Open arms wide with a slight bend at elbows. Feel chest stretch. Bring dumbbells back together in an arc. Squeeze chest at top.

fields.name: Cable Crossover
fields.description: Cable-based chest fly for constant tension through full range of motion.
fields.instructions: Stand between two high cable pulleys. Pull handles down and across body. Squeeze chest hard at the bottom. Return slowly under control.

fields.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
fields.description: Upper chest press on an inclined bench targeting the clavicular pec.
fields.instructions: Set bench to 30-45 degrees. Press dumbbells from shoulder level to full extension overhead. Lower slowly. Focus on upper chest engagement.

fields.name: Machine Chest Press
fields.description: Guided chest press machine, excellent for beginners or isolation work.
fields.instructions: Adjust seat so handles align with mid-chest. Press forward to full extension. Return slowly. Keep back against pad throughout.

fields.name: Tricep Dips
fields.description: Bodyweight compound movement targeting triceps, chest, and shoulders.
fields.instructions: Grip parallel bars, arms straight. Lower body until elbows reach 90 degrees. Press back up to full extension. Keep torso slightly forward for more tricep focus.

fields.name: Skull Crushers
fields.description: Barbell tricep isolation exercise performed lying on a bench.
fields.instructions: Lie on bench, barbell or EZ bar extended above chest. Lower bar toward forehead by bending elbows only. Extend back to start. Keep upper arms still.

fields.name: Cable Tricep Pushdown
fields.description: Cable isolation for the triceps using a rope or bar attachment.
fields.instructions: Stand facing high cable pulley with rope attachment. Push rope down and apart at bottom. Squeeze triceps at full extension. Return slowly.

fields.name: Overhead Tricep Extension
fields.description: Dumbbell tricep isolation targeting the long head with overhead stretch.
fields.instructions: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands. Lower behind head by bending elbows. Press back up. Keep elbows pointing forward.

fields.name: Close Grip Bench Press
fields.description: Barbell press with narrow grip emphasizing triceps over chest.
fields.instructions: Grip barbell shoulder-width or slightly narrower. Lower bar to chest. Press up. Keep elbows tucked close to body to maximize tricep engagement.

fields.name: Barbell Overhead Press
fields.description: Standing or seated compound press for overall shoulder development.
fields.instructions: Stand or sit with barbell at shoulder height. Press overhead to full extension. Lower back to shoulders. Brace core throughout. Do not lean excessively.

fields.name: Dumbbell Overhead Press
fields.description: Seated or standing shoulder press with dumbbells for balanced development.
fields.instructions: Hold dumbbells at shoulder height. Press overhead until arms are straight. Lower slowly. Keep core engaged. Can be done seated for stability.

fields.name: Lateral Raise
fields.description: Side delt isolation movement for wider shoulder appearance.
fields.instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides. Raise arms out to shoulder height with slight bend at elbows. Lower slowly. Lean slightly forward to hit side delts optimally.

fields.name: Front Raise
fields.description: Front delt isolation targeting the anterior shoulder head.
fields.instructions: Hold dumbbells in front of thighs. Raise one or both arms forward to shoulder height. Lower slowly. Avoid swinging torso.

fields.name: Arnold Press
fields.description: Rotating dumbbell press targeting all three shoulder heads.
fields.instructions: Hold dumbbells in front of face, palms facing you. As you press overhead, rotate wrists outward. Reverse rotation as you lower. Full rotation each rep.

fields.name: Barbell Row
fields.description: Classic back compound movement pulling a barbell toward the lower chest.
fields.instructions: Hip-hinge to roughly 45 degrees. Grip barbell. Pull to lower chest keeping elbows tucked. Lower under control. Keep back flat throughout.

fields.name: Pull-Up
fields.description: Bodyweight back and bicep compound using a pull-up bar.
fields.instructions: Hang from bar with overhand grip. Pull body up until chin clears bar. Lower fully. Avoid swinging. Can be assisted with a band for beginners.

fields.name: Lat Pulldown
fields.description: Cable machine vertical pull targeting the latissimus dorsi.
fields.instructions: Sit at cable machine, grip bar wider than shoulder-width. Pull bar down to upper chest. Lean slightly back. Squeeze lats at bottom. Return fully at top.

fields.name: Seated Cable Row
fields.description: Horizontal cable pull for mid-back and lat development.
fields.instructions: Sit at cable row machine, feet on platform. Pull handle to abdomen. Squeeze shoulder blades together. Extend arms fully. Keep torso upright.

fields.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
fields.description: Unilateral back exercise for full range of motion and lat isolation.
fields.instructions: Place one hand and knee on bench for support. Hold dumbbell in free hand. Pull elbow toward hip. Squeeze lat at top. Lower fully.

fields.name: Barbell Curl
fields.description: Classic bicep compound movement with a barbell.
fields.instructions: Stand holding barbell with underhand grip, arms extended. Curl bar toward shoulders. Squeeze biceps at top. Lower fully. Keep upper arms still.

fields.name: Dumbbell Curl
fields.description: Alternating or bilateral dumbbell curl for bicep isolation.
fields.instructions: Stand or sit holding dumbbells. Curl one or both dumbbells to shoulder height. Squeeze at top. Lower fully. Supinate wrist as you curl.

fields.name: Hammer Curl
fields.description: Neutral-grip curl targeting biceps and brachialis for arm thickness.
fields.instructions: Hold dumbbells with neutral grip (palms facing each other). Curl up without rotating wrist. Lower slowly. Targets brachialis more than standard curl.

fields.name: Cable Curl
fields.description: Cable-based bicep curl for constant tension throughout the movement.
fields.instructions: Stand facing low cable pulley with bar or rope. Curl toward shoulders. Squeeze at top. Lower slowly. Constant cable tension targets bicep peak.

fields.name: Rear Delt Fly
fields.description: Rear delt isolation targeting the posterior shoulder head.
fields.instructions: Bend over with dumbbells hanging down. Raise arms out to sides with slight elbow bend. Squeeze rear delts at top. Lower slowly. Can also be done on rear delt machine.

fields.name: Face Pull
fields.description: Cable rear delt and rotator cuff exercise for shoulder health.
fields.instructions: Attach rope to high cable. Pull toward face, elbows high and wide. Externally rotate at end of movement. Return slowly. Great for shoulder health.

fields.name: Barbell Squat
fields.description: King of lower body exercises. Barbell on back, squat to parallel or below.
fields.instructions: Bar on upper traps. Feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out. Squat to at least parallel. Drive through heels to stand. Keep chest up and knees tracking over toes.

fields.name: Leg Press
fields.description: Machine quad compound exercise as an alternative to squatting.
fields.instructions: Sit in machine, feet shoulder-width on platform. Lower platform until knees are at 90 degrees. Press back up. Never lock knees at top. Control the descent.

fields.name: Leg Extension
fields.description: Machine quad isolation exercise targeting the front of the thigh.
fields.instructions: Sit in leg extension machine, pad on lower shin. Extend legs to full height. Squeeze quads at top. Lower slowly. Avoid swinging.

fields.name: Goblet Squat
fields.description: Beginner-friendly squat holding a kettlebell or dumbbell at chest.
fields.instructions: Hold kettlebell or dumbbell at chest level. Squat down, keeping weight close to body. Push knees out. Return to stand. Great for learning squat form.

fields.name: Romanian Deadlift
fields.description: Hip-hinge movement targeting hamstrings and glutes through a long stretch.
fields.instructions: Hold barbell or dumbbells. Hinge at hips, pushing them back as bar travels down thighs. Feel hamstring stretch. Drive hips forward to return. Keep back flat.

fields.name: Lying Leg Curl
fields.description: Machine hamstring isolation exercise performed lying face-down.
fields.instructions: Lie face-down on leg curl machine. Curl heels toward glutes. Squeeze hamstrings at top. Lower fully. Control the eccentric.

fields.name: Conventional Deadlift
fields.description: Full posterior chain compound lift. The most fundamental strength exercise.
fields.instructions: Stand with bar over mid-foot. Hinge to grip bar, hips above knees. Push floor away, drag bar up thighs. Lock out at top. Lower with control. Brace hard.

fields.name: Sumo Deadlift
fields.description: Wide-stance deadlift variation emphasizing glutes and inner thighs.
fields.instructions: Take wide stance, toes pointed out. Grip bar inside legs. Push knees out over toes as you pull. Hips come forward at lockout. Keep chest up.

fields.name: Hip Thrust
fields.description: Glute isolation movement using a bench and barbell for maximum glute activation.
fields.instructions: Upper back on bench, bar across hips. Drive hips up to full extension. Squeeze glutes hard at top. Lower hips to floor. Pause and repeat.

fields.name: Glute Bridge
fields.description: Bodyweight glute activation exercise performed on the floor.
fields.instructions: Lie on back, knees bent, feet flat. Drive hips up by squeezing glutes. Hold at top. Lower slowly. Can progress by adding weight plate on hips.

fields.name: Dumbbell Lunge
fields.description: Unilateral leg exercise for quad, glute, and balance development.
fields.instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides. Step forward into lunge position. Lower back knee toward floor. Push off front foot to return. Alternate legs or complete one side at a time.

fields.name: Standing Calf Raise
fields.description: Calf isolation exercise targeting the gastrocnemius muscle.
fields.instructions: Stand on edge of step or flat floor. Rise onto toes as high as possible. Squeeze calves at top. Lower heel below starting point for full stretch. Add weight to progress.

fields.name: Plank
fields.description: Isometric core stability exercise targeting the entire midsection.
fields.instructions: Forearms on floor, body in straight line from head to heels. Brace core and squeeze glutes. Hold position. Do not let hips sag or pike. Breathe steadily.

fields.name: Crunch
fields.description: Classic core flexion exercise targeting the rectus abdominis.
fields.instructions: Lie on back, knees bent. Curl shoulders toward knees. Squeeze abs at top. Lower slowly. Do not pull neck with hands. Focus on spinal flexion.

fields.name: Hanging Knee Raise
fields.description: Core and hip flexor exercise hanging from a pull-up bar.
fields.instructions: Hang from bar with straight arms. Raise knees toward chest. Squeeze abs at top. Lower slowly. Progress to straight leg raises.

fields.name: Russian Twist
fields.description: Rotational core exercise targeting the obliques.
fields.instructions: Sit with torso slightly back, feet raised. Twist torso side to side. Can hold a weight plate or medicine ball. Keep lower back stable.

fields.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
fields.description: Advanced core compound exercise for full abdominal wall and stability.
fields.instructions: Kneel holding ab wheel. Roll forward as far as possible while maintaining control. Pull back to start by contracting core. Keep hips low. Very advanced.

fields.name: Mountain Climber
fields.description: Core and cardio bodyweight exercise done from a plank position.
fields.instructions: Start in high plank. Drive alternating knees toward chest in rapid succession. Keep hips level. Breathe steadily. Increases in speed for cardio effect.

fields.name: Treadmill Run
fields.description: Steady-state or interval cardio on a treadmill.
fields.instructions: Set treadmill to appropriate speed and incline. Maintain upright posture. Swing arms naturally. Start with moderate pace and increase as fitness improves.

fields.name: Stationary Bike
fields.description: Low-impact cardiovascular conditioning on a stationary bike.
fields.instructions: Adjust seat height so leg is nearly straight at bottom of pedal stroke. Pedal at a steady pace. Increase resistance for more intensity. Great for knee-friendly cardio.

fields.name: Rowing Machine
fields.description: Full-body cardio and back exercise on a rowing ergometer.
fields.instructions: Sit on rower, strap in feet. Drive with legs first, then lean back, then pull handle to chest. Reverse order on return. Legs drive 70% of the power.

fields.name: Jumping Jacks
fields.description: Simple bodyweight cardio movement accessible to all fitness levels.
fields.instructions: Stand with feet together. Jump feet apart while raising arms overhead. Jump back to start. Repeat at a steady rhythm. Use as warm-up or active cardio filler.
